user.title: KOVnet parent portal
user.description: Log in with your KOVnet parent account (the same as in the KOVnet Ouderapp).

code.title: Verification code
code.description: KOVnet has emailed a four-digit code to {email}. Enter it here. You only need to do this once; after that Home Assistant uses a token that stays valid for about a year. No code, or has it expired? Tick 'Send a new code' and submit.

account.title: Choose organisation
account.description: This email address has accounts at multiple organisations.

contracts.title: Choose children
contracts.description: Each selected contract gets its own device with a calendar and sensors.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to KOVnet again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {email} is no longer valid. Enter your password; if two-factor authentication is on, KOVnet will email a code next.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed, check email and password.
error.invalid_code: The code was not accepted. Check the latest KOVnet email, or tick 'Send a new code'.
error.code_resent: KOVnet has emailed a new code. Enter it below.

abort.already_configured: This KOVnet account is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not load the KOVnet profile.
abort.no_contracts: No current childcare contracts found for this account.
